text:
Priya: Quick sync — we should add a few new columns to the fallback compatibility matrix: tokenizer-diff, max-context-behavior, and tool-call-signature-parity. Link: https://go/reorg/fallback-matrix :memo:
Jamie: +1. Also want a column for 'expected latency delta' when fallback occurs (helps tier routing decisions).
Alex: Important for quotas too — if fallback to smaller model increases per-request tokens, cost bump needs to be surfaced on the console.
Morgan: Telemetry note: add a histogram for 'fallback_reasons' and tag by region + customer_tier so we can alert on spikes.
Taylor: We hit a tokenizer edge where short-prompt padding made tool calls break. I'll add a minimal repro and a unit test.
Priya: Good. For the tool-call parity column, let's define enumerated values: FULL | TRIMMED_ARGS | NOT_SUPPORTED. Keeps checks programmatic.
Jamie: Example routing policy snippet I'm proposing for console rollouts (canary -> 10% tier=enterprise region=eu):
```
routing_policies:
  - name: canary-eu-enterprise
    match:
      region: eu
      customer_tier: enterprise
    rollout: 0.10
    fallback_order: [variant-v2, variant-v1-small]
```
Jamie: Fallback_order should be validated against matrix compatibility. If tokenizer-diff != NONE then warn in UI.
Alex: UX ask: when creating that policy in Console, surface a real-time estimate of token delta and cost delta. Even a small per-request delta at scale matters.
Morgan: For telemetry, we should emit `fallback_evaluated` traces with fields: chosen_variant, reason, tokenizer_diff, context_clamped (bool). That lets us compute signal-to-noise for false positives.
Priya: Agree. Also we need migration guidance for Dedicated customers: if they pin variants, warn them about tool-call/signature mismatches. Maybe a modal during pinning.
Taylor: Re tokenizer parity: sometimes it's a preprocessing tokenization change (whitespace vs punctuation). We should add a normalized tokenizer id in the matrix and a short script to diff outputs. I can prototype.
Alex: Can we expose a per-route 'compatibility score' (0-100) computed from the matrix? Console can use it for an allow/block toggle before rollout.
Jamie: That score should penalize mismatches more if the route has tool-calls enabled. Tool-calls = critical.
Priya: Action items: Taylor prototype tokenizer diff script, Morgan add histogram + traces, Jamie wire UI warning on routing creation, Alex mock cost delta widget for Console. I'll update the sheet and tag everyone.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:15 UTC to test the new telemetry flags. :rocket:
